SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_CONTENT.title: Enable StS1 Content
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_CONTENT.hover.title: Enable StS1 Content
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_CONTENT.hover.desc: Master switch. When OFF, all Slay the Spire 1 content from this mod is gated off while the mod stays installed.
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_CHARACTERS.title: StS1 Characters
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_CHARACTERS.hover.desc: Show the StS1 characters ("StS1 - X") in character select.
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_CARDS.title: StS1 Cards
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_CARDS.hover.title: StS1 Cards
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_CARDS.hover.desc: Inject StS1 colorless cards into the shared reward pool.
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_RELICS.title: StS1 Relics
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_RELICS.hover.title: StS1 Relics
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_RELICS.hover.desc: Inject StS1 relics into the shared reward pools.
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_POWERS.title: StS1 Powers
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_POWERS.hover.title: StS1 Powers
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_POWERS.hover.desc: Allow StS1 custom power models to be applied during a run. When OFF, this gate blocks StS1 custom powers and PowerCmd effects whose cardSource is a Spire1 card, including vanilla power effects triggered by Spire1 cards (for example Strength or Poison). It does not block unrelated vanilla powers or effects from other mods' cards. Default ON, matching the behavior before this switch existed. Read at effect application time and snapshotted per run: changing it only affects runs started afterwards, and loading a save always uses that save's value.
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_POTIONS.title: StS1 Potions
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_POTIONS.hover.title: StS1 Potions
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_POTIONS.hover.desc: Inject StS1 potions into the reward pools. Default ON, matching the behavior before this switch existed. Read at pool/query time and snapshotted per run: changing it only affects runs started afterwards, and loading a save always uses that save's value.
SPIRE1-PURE_STS1_POOLS.title: Pure StS1 Pools
SPIRE1-PURE_STS1_POOLS.hover.title: Pure StS1 Pools
SPIRE1-PURE_STS1_POOLS.hover.desc: Custom character pools skip identical official StS2 cards and fill with our StS1-faithful implementations instead. Reward counts are clamped to what the pool can actually offer.
SPIRE1-DEBUG_SHOW_LOC_KEYS.title: Show Loc Keys
SPIRE1-DEBUG_SHOW_LOC_KEYS.hover.title: Show Loc Keys
SPIRE1-DEBUG_SHOW_LOC_KEYS.hover.desc: Append a localization key (e.g. SPIRE1-STRIKE.title) to every mod string in-game for debugging and console spawning.
SPIRE1-POOL_CENSUS_ON_MENU_ENTER.title: Pool Census On Menu Enter
SPIRE1-POOL_CENSUS_ON_MENU_ENTER.hover.d: Run the ordered pool census once on the next main menu entry. Diagnostics only, and deliberately never at mod-initializer time: reading a pool's AllCards freezes that pool and locks later-loading mods out of adding to it. The poolcensus console command runs the same report on demand.
SPIRE1-IGNORE_MP_MOD_DIFFERENCES.title: MP: Ignore Mod Differences
SPIRE1-IGNORE_MP_MOD_DIFFERENCES.hover.d: Ignore the peers' mod-list differences during the handshake. This setting alone does not bypass ModelID hash mismatches: those additionally require explicitly enabling the separate MP: Ignore ModelID Hash Mismatch setting (off by default; weakens serialization safety). Real game-version mismatches still block. Also suppresses the RitsuLib divergence popup. Fully effective only when both peers run this build; diagnostics still land in the logs directory.
SPIRE1-IGNORE_MP_HASH_MISMATCH.title: MP: Ignore ModelID Hash Mismatch
SPIRE1-IGNORE_MP_HASH_MISMATCH.hover.des: MP tolerance at the hash level: allow the handshake when the game version matches but the ModelID hash differs. The hash fingerprints the gameplay content, so forcing this weakens serialization safety. Keep it off unless both peers deliberately run different builds.
SPIRE1-ENABLE_SKIP_NODE_BUTTON.title: Map Skip-Node Button
SPIRE1-ENABLE_SKIP_NODE_BUTTON.hover.des: Show a rescue button on the map screen: if you are stuck in a room, unlock map travel and click your next node. Uses the native vote pipeline - no desync risk.
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_EVENTS.title: Inject StS1 events into event pools
SPIRE1-ENABLE_STS1_EVENTS.hover.desc: Off by default; existing explicit settings are preserved. Requires the master content switch to be on. When on: StS1 events (The Divine Fountain, A Note For Yourself, Pleading Vagrant, Augmenter, Ancient Writing) are registered into the shared/act event pools and can appear in any run. When off: they are filtered out of every act event pool at room-generation / next-event time and never roll. (Spire Heart is never auto-registered.)
SPIRE1-REGISTER_CONTENT_NEXT_RUN.title: Register Content Into Next Run
SPIRE1-REGISTER_CONTENT_NEXT_RUN.hover.d: On by default. Controls what NEW runs register: cards / relics / events / potions are injected into their reward or event pools, while custom powers are applied at effect time by the runtime powers gate. Unlike the switches above, this choice is snapshotted into each run's save when the run is created: changing it only affects runs you start afterwards, and loading any save always uses the value that save was created with. Saves made before this option existed are treated as ON. Character visibility is decided at character-select (before a run exists) and is unaffected.
